# `company.custom_field_values`

Stable typed custom-field value slots attached polymorphically to supported aggregate records.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Stable ULID reused when a cleared custom-field value is set again. |
| `def_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | unique with def_id + record_type + record_id | ix_custom_field_values_def_id | custom_field_defs.id | Custom-field definition id governing this value. |
| `record_type` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | unique with def_id + record_type + record_id | ix_custom_field_values_owner | — | Stable owner record type for this value. |
| `record_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | unique with def_id + record_type + record_id | ix_custom_field_values_owner | — | Stable owner record id for this value. |
| `active` | BOOLEAN | no | true | — | — | — | Whether this value appears in the owner's current custom-field projection. |
| `canonical_text` | TEXT | no | — | — | — | — | Canonical kind-dependent value representation preserved across clear and restore. |
